outline:
先修課程:4401051或負責教授同意
This course introduces the fundamental Engineering drawing from mechanical parts to assembly drawings. The software, AutoCAD, is employed to develop the CAD drawing skills.
schedule:
Week 1: Course introduction, AutoCAD environment
Week 2: Plane drawing, drawing frame
Week 3: Projection, 3-view drawing
Week 4: Sectional view
Week 5: Dimensioning
Week 6: Tolerance
Week 7: Clearance/ Inteference
Week 8: Surface treatment
Week 9: Screw
Week 10: Bearing / Chamfer / Round
Week 11: Assembly
Week 12: Assembly
Week 13: Assembly
Week 14: 3D drawing
Week 15: 3D drawing
Week 16: 3D drawing
Week 17: Flexible Learning
Week 18: Flexible Learning

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content:
Week 17: Each group select the appropriate theme before Week 16 and follow the instruction to assign the tasks.
Week 18: In terms of the discussion results in Week 17, each group delivers the complet report.
flexible_learning.outcome: The discussion records in Week 17 and the complete report in Week 18.

assessment:
In-class assignments 80%
Group discussion record 5%
Group complete report 15%
